rv.q: A sweet, slapdash evening for fans of these talented performers
This 90-minute trip down memory lane is a loving and lighthearted reminder of how finding joy and camaraderie in community is essential to braving the world as a big girl.
Mama, I’m A Big Girl Now is a pleasing and satisfying musical evening as well as trip down memory lane for musical theatergoers.

Both Bundy and Butler left July 13, 2003. But here’s the point: Unlike many cast members who, on quitting a show and swearing to maintain the tight friendships that have developed and then drift apart, Winokur, Bundy and Butler haven’t. Indeed, perhaps the most delightful aspect of Mama I’m a Big Girl Now!
Marissa Jaret Winokur, Laura Bell Bundy, and Kerry Butler are three powerhouses who prove time can’t stop the beat of their talent and friendship.

cn.t: Three Hairspray alums reunite for a spirited, nostalgic revue that charms with genuine friendship and Broadway talent, though critics find it more sweet than substantive.
